name: Asuha
source:
A boy living in Yomi.
After the time skip, he is studying hard to enroll in Jintoku Academy.
He admires [url=/c74514]Kuroba[/url] and aspires to be a doctor like him.
He was raised in the same orphanage as [url=/c153386]Hairi[/url] and thinks of him as a brother.
